title: Investigating histone deubiquitination: _Xenopus_ manipulations
protocol: Inject 300-600 pg of IgG or anti-Ubp-M antibody into both blastomeres of two-cell stage embryos.
Collect the embryos at tailbud stages for in situ hybridization with HoxD10, Sox2, Otx2, En2 and Krox20 antisense RNA probes.
Collect the embryos at tadpole stages for morphological assessment.
Mix an equal amount of Ubp-M antigen peptide with the antibody on ice for at least 30 min before coinjection into the embryos.
Perform whole-mount in situ hybridization as described.
